description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusDeviceManagementAdapter' that connects a device management service with an event bus framework, handling various device operations such as create, get, update, and delete via processing messages received on a specific event bus address.

classes.name: EventBusDeviceManagementAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class that bridges device management requests received on an event bus to a device management service, handling message processing for create, get, update, and delete device operations.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Routes incoming event bus messages to the appropriate device operation handler based on the operation specified.

methods.name: processCustomDeviceMessage
methods.description: Handles non-standard device management messages; default implementation returns a failed future with a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: deviceFromPayload
methods.description: Converts the payload within an event bus message to a Device object, failing if payload is invalid.

methods.name: fromPayload
methods.description: Static method that parses an EventBusMessage's JSON payload into a Device object.

methods.name: processCreateRequest
methods.description: Processes a create device request message, invoking service create method and managing tracing.

methods.name: processGetRequest
methods.description: Processes a get device request message, invoking service read method and managing tracing.

methods.name: processUpdateRequest
methods.description: Processes an update device request message, invoking service update method and managing tracing.

methods.name: processDeleteRequest
methods.description: Processes a delete device request message, invoking service delete method and managing tracing.
